description: This file defines a RESTful API resource class for managing accounting GL closures in a Fineract-based financial application. It includes endpoints to list, retrieve, create, update, and delete accounting closure records, and utilizes Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: GLClosuresApiResource
classes.description: A REST API resource class handling CRUD operations for accounting GL closures, secured via user permissions, and annotated for Swagger documentation.

methods.name: retrieveAllClosures
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve list of all GL closures, optionally filtered by officeId.

methods.name: retreiveClosure
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a specific GL closure by ID, with optional detail fields.

methods.name: createGLClosure
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new GL closure record from provided data.

methods.name: updateGLClosure
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing GL closure, allowing modification of comments.

methods.name: deleteGLClosure
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove the latest GL closure for a specified ID.
